description: This file contains implementation of functions related to setting up and managing DRM (Direct Rendering Manager) resources such as encoders, connectors, CRTCs, and planes for a Linux-based display subsystem. It includes resource allocation, cleanup, and property retrieval functions specific to handling DRM components.

methods.name: kms_setup_encoder
methods.description: Sets up the encoder for a given DRM context by iterating through available encoders and matching the encoder ID or possible CRTCs.

methods.name: kms_setup_connector
methods.description: Finds and assigns a connected DRM connector to the context.

methods.name: kms_setup_crtc
methods.description: Configures the CRTC (display controller) associated with the encoder in the DRM context.

methods.name: kms_setup
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a kms_ctx structure with DRM resources and setups connector, encoder, and CRTC.

methods.name: kms_cleanup_context
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with the kms_ctx structure, including connector, encoder, CRTC, and resource handles.

methods.name: kms_get_properties
methods.description: Retrieves the property ID for a specified property name from DRM object properties.

methods.name: kms_get_plane
methods.description: Enumerates all DRM planes (primary and overlay), retrieves their properties, and identifies primary and overlay plane IDs.
